Independently audit all 24 anonymous prose/reader entries in {WORKSPACE}/packets/fine.json using only those fictional premises. No browsing, oracles, mappings, guides, other outputs, history or agents. Fidelity pass means supported claims; concern means consequential ambiguous scope/missing claim condition; fail means materially false event/attribution. Missing explanation is not automatically false science. For each critical question, classify the support IN THE PROSE as supported (explicit or necessarily entailed), missing (requires absent information), contradicted (text answers it incompatibly with evidence), or uncertain (source/prose insufficient to decide). Legitimate omissions outside the requested relation are not errors.
